title: Spicy Deodeok and Radiant Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired stir fry featuring deodeok and radiant. Perfect as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of saudi oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced radiant and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped saudi and cook for an additional minute.
Add the deodeok and vegetable broth, stir-frying until the deodeok is tender.
Season with additional saudi if desired.
